# Stylos

> Stylos is a one-person web design studio in Oxford, founded by classicist and archaeologist Arkadiy Avdokhin. The studio creates websites, research platforms, digital exhibitions, and portfolios for research, heritage, and creative practice — built by an active Oxford academic.

Canonical website: https://www.stylos.uk/

Contact: studio@stylos.uk

## Services

- Research websites and public-facing grant platforms
- Digital exhibitions and cultural-heritage interfaces
- 3D visualisation and photogrammetry integration
- Portfolios for artists and independent practitioners
- Frontend design, Firebase-backed content systems, and lightweight back offices

## Selected work

- Aphrodisias 3D Epigraphy: an online platform of interactive 3D models and scholarly object records from late antique Aphrodisias, University of Oxford
- Festivals & Society: a public-facing website and searchable database on festivals in Roman-era Egypt, University of Vienna — https://festivals-egypt.org
- Portrait painter: a portfolio website for an Oxford-based painter, with an artist's back office and a managed image pipeline
- Immersive story artist portfolio: an animated portfolio for a London-based performer, with a back office and online checkout
- Independent school: a pilot website system for a small private school in Oxford
